author: More Perfect Union
description:
Atrium Health, a giant conglomerate known for suing patients over their medical bills, is on the verge of merging with non-profit WakeMed Health.

WakeMed is a beloved small group of community hospitals in North Carolina, and residents are fighting back, trying to preserve the independence of good, local hospitals.

On Monday the Wake County Board of Commissioners plans to vote on the merger.

Producer: trevorp_hayes
Editor: kungaaaaaaaa
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: This health care giant sued patients for unpaid medical bills. It’s taking over a community hospital
